{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Check news fragments filenames, build documentation, check links, spelling, grammar, and style
permissions:
  contents: read
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
  # Build pull requests
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'Makefile'
      - 'src/icalendar/*.py'
      - 'src/icalendar/cal/*.py'
      - 'src/icalendar/prop/*.py'
      - 'src/icalendar/timezone/*.py'
      - 'styles/**'
      - '.github/workflows/documentation.yml'
      - '.readthedocs.yaml'
      - '.vale.ini'
      - 'news/*.*'

jobs:
  docs:
    name: Documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.11', '3.14']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
        with:
          # UV_VERSION can be set in the repository settings:
          # Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions or click here:
          # https://github.com/PyCalendar/icalendar/settings/variables/actions
          # -> Variables -> UV_VERSION
          version: "${{ vars.UV_VERSION }}"

      - name: Cache uv dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/uv
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock', 'pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ matrix.python-version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-uv-

      - name: Create Python virtual environment, install requirements
        run: make .venv PYTHONVERSION=${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Check news fragments filenames
        run: make changes-check PYTHONVERSION=${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Build HTML documentation
        run: make html PYTHONVERSION=${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Run vale
        run: make vale VALEOPTS="--minAlertLevel='warning'" PYTHONVERSION=${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Check for broken links
        run: make linkcheckbroken PYTHONVERSION=${{ matrix.python-version }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow installs Python dependencies via `uv sync` on every run without caching. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern identifies caching dependency downloads as a measurable optimization when repeated dependency fetching occurs and cache inputs include lockfiles and environment. Experimental evidence (batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) demonstrates ~9% elapsed time savings from adding a pip cache step in a similar Python workflow. Adding a cache step for uv's cache directory (~/.cache/uv) keyed by Python version and lockfiles (uv.lock, pyproject.toml) will avoid repeated downloads on subsequent runs while preserving all build and test coverage. No permissions are weakened and no new network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
